groups.name: renders CodeMode values nested inside logged containers
error values stringify like JS Error.prototype.toString
Date() without new returns a deterministic ISO string and ignores arguments
RegExp with non-string flags throws a SyntaxError, like JS
string replacers reject opaque callables with the wrap hint, not a type error
caught failures carry the constructor name the real-JS failure would have
includes, startsWith, and endsWith reject regular expressions with a TypeError
behave as an empty pattern like native JS
feature detection on missing statics works like native JS
known statics still resolve and run
global exec advances lastIndex across calls
lastIndex is writable and exec coerces its stored value
exec coerces CodeMode data objects assigned to lastIndex
non-global exec and test coerce and preserve lastIndex
an unmatched string pattern returns null
matchAll materializes match arrays with captures
function replacers receive captures, offsets, input, and named groups
function replacers support string searches, zero-length matches, and result coercion
promise-returning string replacers are coerced synchronously
replaceAll without the g flag is a catchable error
new RegExp constructs from strings; invalid patterns are catchable
invalid patterns fail with actionable messages
missing g-flag errors say how to fix the call
a non-pattern argument names the expected shapes
source and flags properties read through
regexes serialize to {} at the boundary, like JSON
template interpolation renders the literal form
Object values and entries accept arrays
instanceof recognizes the stdlib value types
realistic pipeline: parse, extract with regex, dedupe, count by day
RegExp.escape encodes syntax, punctuators, whitespace, and surrogates
RegExp.escape preserves ordinary ASCII and Unicode code points
d flag exposes match indices through exec, match, and matchAll
match indices preserve captures, Unicode offsets, and groups properties
match and matchAll preserve named, unmatched, and blocked index groups
v flag exposes unicodeSets and remains exclusive with u
